title: forge build data
description: Payload of `forge build --json`: what was built (or, with `--dry-run`, what would be built after validation).

path.description: The file or directory passed to `forge build`.

output_name.description: Binary name from the manifest or `--output`.

binary_path.description: Where the binary was written. On a dry run this is the path it would take.

program_kind.description: Kind detected from the merged program (`ProgramKind`'s debug name).

dry_run.description: `--dry-run` was passed: validation only, nothing written.
